description: Land Title Settlement Department - Weliweriya West, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820016
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
